pages.text: Build a frame of runestone like a Nether portal: from 2 up to 21x21 empty blocks inside. Runestone: 8 stone bricks around lapis lazuli.
Light the frame with the Rune Igniter (flint, runestone, a fang of Cerberus and a scale of Zmey Gorynych). The rainbow of Bifrost shines inside: step into it. Break the frame and the portal goes out.
